stages.label: Inspire
stages.question: What's worth making, and what does good look like?
playbook: Drop new links into content/inbox/<date>.md under ## kind / group, with a short note on why
Run pnpm inbox <file> to preview, then --apply to add them
Pick 3 references (ui references, portfolios) to steal from

stages.label: Design
stages.question: How should it look and feel?
playbook: Choose a style family: pixel & ascii, glass, neobrutalism or hand-drawn
Pick icons, fonts and a background from their groups
Check the screen against the Interface Cheat Sheet

stages.label: Build
stages.question: What do I reuse instead of writing?
playbook: Filter pricing → free first; free + pro only if the free part is enough
Search component libraries, motion and charts before writing a component
Load the matching skill packs into the agent

stages.label: Ship
stages.question: Is it ready, and how do I show it?
playbook: Record the demo with a video tool
Mark what you actually used as core

stages.label: Learn
stages.question: What do I keep from this?
playbook: Write a one-line note on each item you tried: keep, or why not
Move unused to-try items out every month
Read one piece of writing a week
